subject: MAP & acceptance window — proposed rebaseline and credit request
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena@aurorahealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: samir.p@aurorahealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: acceptance window slippage — immediate ask

Tessa / Priyom,

Quick note from Aurora after today's internal gating review — we missed the data-mapping milestone and that pushes our acceptance window beyond the originally agreed go-live (2025-06-02). We need to understand:

- What the revised MAP looks like if we move the acceptance target by 2 weeks.
- What credits or runway Redwood can provide for operational risk if the cutover slides past our fiscal close (we're sensitive to vendor credits in our procurement calendar).

Attached our internal redline of the MAP (high level). We're willing to accept a short checklist-based acceptance (smoke tests + 1 P0 scenario) to shorten verification time, but we need commitments on turnaround for fixes and a guarded fallback plan.

Can you propose a containment plan by EOD tomorrow? Our procurement lead (Samir) will need language for the SOW/PO change.

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Morris
Director of Digital Transformation
Aurora Health
elena@aurorahealth.com
(415) 555-0184
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morris <elena@aurorahealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: acceptance window slippage — immediate ask

Elena / Samir — thanks for the heads-up. We ran a quick triage with engineering and CS. High level containment proposal:

1) Short-term MAP rewrite (attached): move Acceptance Date to 2025-06-16, with a hard smoke-test signoff that covers the 3 P0 flows you flagged.
2) Interim SLA: Redwood will commit a 48-hour turnaround for P0 fixes during the containment window (May 13 — Jun 16).
3) Credit: we can offer a one-time operational credit equal to 5% of the next month's committed bill if final acceptance occurs after 2025-06-16. We can formalize in an amendment to the SOW.
4) Canary fallback: we propose a phased cutover (week 0 canary + week 1 broad) with an automatic rollback trigger based on error rate and latency thresholds. Priyom will include the rollback guard rails.

Deliverables I will send by EOD tomorrow:
- Revised MAP (Aurora_MAP_v3.xlsx) — draft for your legal/procurement redline.
- Acceptance checklist (smoke tests + P0 verification steps).
- Proposed amendment text for the credit and revised acceptance date.

If that framework works, we can lock on the amended dates and I will loop Lauren for exec approval on the credit.

Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Director, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0132
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, Elena Morris <elena@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: acceptance window slippage — immediate ask

Adding the technical containment notes and a short risk register:

Summary: missed milestone was data mapping validation for two connectors (ClaimsFeed and PatientSync). Root cause appears to be schema variations in PatientSync; mapping team needs two additional days for reconciliation.

Technical containment steps (what we'll do):
- Freeze connector config as of 2025-05-13 09:00 PDT to avoid schema churn.
- Provide a nightly validation job to Aurora that highlights rows failing mapping rules; target time-to-insight: 6 hours.
- Deliver a patch for PatientSync mapping by 2025-05-15 17:00 PDT; Redwood will run an accelerated regression suite over the next 24 hours.
- Canary plan (detailed): 50 requests/min for the canary week, automatic throttle if error rate > 1.5% for 5m window. Rollback trigger tied to a fatal error code set.

Open risks:
- If additional schema changes occur after the freeze, timeline slides again.
- SOC2 evidence request (Samir): we can provide the access log export and evidence bundle by May 14 but redaction work may delay by 24 hours.

I'll attach the rollback checklist and the short tech runbook to the MAP draft. Priyom
From: Elena Morris <elena@aurorahealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@aurorahealth.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: acceptance window slippage — immediate ask

Tessa / Priyom — thanks for the fast turnaround and the concrete steps. We reviewed Aurora_MAP_v3.xlsx and the acceptance checklist; Samir and I spoke with procurement and the proposed 5% one-time credit is acceptable as a starting point. A couple of clarifications before we finalize the amendment:

- Can you make the credit language conditional on final acceptance occurring after 2025-06-16 (explicitly tie it to final sign-off date)?
- We need to confirm the 48-hour P0 SLA applies to production incidents during the containment window (May 13 — Jun 16). Please confirm in writing.
- Please include a short paragraph in the amendment that references the canary rollback thresholds (error rate and fatal code triggers) so our release engineering has alignment.

Assuming the above are explicit in the doc, Aurora will sign the amendment and proceed with the revised MAP. We'll also route for exec FYI — looping in our CTO if needed.

Appreciate the urgency.

Elena

--
Elena Morris
Director of Digital Transformation
Aurora Health
